facts.fact: A MACRA Director General slide deck states Malawi has one IXP, in Blantyre (Southern region); the deck is undated and its latest internal date is September 2023, so 2023-10 is a proxy.
The MACRA deck states Malawi has only one IXP, in Blantyre; no networks from abroad are mentioned; the deck is undated, latest internal date September 2023, so 2023-10 is a proxy.

note: Lilongwe and Mzuzu IXPs are planned: MACRA was procuring equipment for MISPA.
